$comment: Budgets and timeouts per node kind (Design principles 101 item 37: 'budgets are set in the design; code that runs over budget is status SLOW and becomes a bottleneck work order'). nodes.<name> overrides its kind; BUDGET= and TIMEOUT= arguments override both. Read by bin/timed-run.sh, timing/node-timing.sh and timing/line-timing.sh.
wo_epic_title: Bottlenecks: nodes over budget or past timeout (item 37)
